_readme: Minimal fixture for __tests__/migration-062-verifier-catalog-rendering-fix.test.ts. The four RLS policies as pg_policies rendered them on staging, captured read-only at commit 675bb380123860ac11a11b603c8ecdcac4e76a0f. Only the six fields the assertions read are kept; the capture metadata, table inventory and package counts of the original evidence file are deliberately not committed. The point of these rows is their RAW multi-line rendering: the test proves that catalog output differs byte-wise from the verifier expected quals yet normalises onto them. Do not reflow, reindent or regenerate this from the verifier SQL — that would make the assertion circular.
